column5: The scenario is prepared to drive one persistent authenticated stock MySQL connection through the Rust SQL node and real three-PD/three-TiKV topology while asserting exact inclusive signed-handle ranges for all six comparisons, reversed operands, bounded intersection, disjoint not-equal, MIN/MAX points, a zero-range contradiction with null snapshot and no transport, and a stored-column residual Selection. Embedded jq contract tests fail closed on full-range substitution and cover exact, split, empty, and residual immutable snapshots. The live cluster has not yet been run against the in-flight executor API; the source add-index workload, partitions, concurrent DDL, broad type matrix, failpoint workload, and general RealTiKV test utilities remain open.
